name: Stone Age: Anniversary

categories.label: Points on scoring track before final scoring
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track trước khi tính cuối game
categories.hint: Everything scored during play: building tiles, immediate card points, minus 10 per unpaid food shortfall.

categories.label: Civilization cards (green): sets of different cards, squared
categories.labelVi: Thẻ văn minh xanh lá: bộ khác nhau, bình phương
categories.hint: Size of each set of different green cards, squared. Enter the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th set size (0 if none).

categories.label: Farmers x agriculture track
categories.labelVi: Nông dân x mức nông nghiệp
categories.hint: Number of farmer symbols times your marker position on the agriculture track.

categories.label: Tool makers x total tool value
categories.labelVi: Thợ chế tác x tổng giá trị công cụ
categories.hint: Number of tool-maker symbols times total value of your tool tiles.

categories.label: Builders x building tiles
categories.labelVi: Thợ xây x số ô công trình
categories.hint: Number of builder symbols times number of building tiles you own.

categories.label: Shamans x figures
categories.hint: Number of shaman symbols times figures on your board.

categories.label: Remaining resources (not food)
categories.labelVi: Tài nguyên còn lại (không tính thức ăn)
categories.hint: 1 point per wood, clay, stone, gold left.

categories.label: Tiebreak: agriculture level + total tool value + figures
categories.labelVi: Phá hòa: nông nghiệp + công cụ + số quân
categories.hint: Not scored; compare only when tied.

tiebreakers.description: Highest sum of agriculture level, total tool value and number of figures

notes: family: set-collection. Rulebook checked is the base-game Stone Age rulebook (Hans im Gluck / Z-Man); Anniversary rules assumed identical for scoring but the Anniversary-edition rulebook itself could not be downloaded. Green set sizes are limited to four sets in this template. Game ends when the Civilization card row cannot be refilled or a Building pile is empty (that round is completed).
